meta.name: verify-unattended
meta.description: Install, instrument and verify a web app end to end without pausing for a human. Use in an autonomous or goal-mode agent, in CI, or in any client that asks for approval on every command: it never says "restart your client" or "open a browser", because it takes a route that needs neither. Prefer the normal install-and-verify skill when a human is present and can answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 无需人工确认即可装好并验证网页应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用自动化代理或 CI 跑任务,却总被要求逐条确认命令。
copy.tagline_en: Install and verify a web app end to end with no human approval
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent or CI must set up and verify an app with no one to approve commands

howto.what: Claude 会在无人在场时把 web 应用装好、接上探针并跑完验证,最后给出 verified: yes / no / unknown 的结论,不要求你重启客户端或自己开浏览器标签页。
howto.when: 当你在自主或目标模式 agent、CI,或每条命令都要审批的客户端里让它安装并验证应用时,它接管执行,全程不等人。

say.text: 无人值守把这个应用装好并验证,给出结论
say.note: 先 init 接线,再起服务、驱动应用、报结果

say.text: 结果为什么是 unknown,是哪一步没读到
用 CLI 跑 reticle verify,把退出码告诉我
say.note: 没有 MCP 工具时走 CLI 路线出退出码

howto.what_en: Claude installs, instruments and verifies a web app with no human in the loop: it starts the dev server, drives the app and reports a verdict (yes/no/unknown) rather than asking you to restart or open a browser.
howto.when_en: Use in an autonomous or goal-mode agent, in CI, or in any client that approves each command; it takes a route that needs no restart and no browser tab.

say_en.text: Install and verify this app unattended, then give me the verdict
say_en.note: Wires up via init, starts the server, drives the app

say_en.text: Why is the verdict unknown, and which step was unread
say_en.note: Reads back the unknown and outcome_unread reasons

say_en.text: Run reticle verify from the CLI and tell me the exit code
say_en.note: CLI route when no MCP tools are present
